---
title: "Blog"
description: "Japanese posts and translated English articles."
listing:
  - id: listing-ja
    contents:
      - "posts/**/*.qmd"
      - "!en/posts/**/*.qmd"
      - "!starter-template/posts/**/*.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    type: table
    fields: [date, title, description]
    field-links: [title]
    categories: true
    date-format: iso
  - id: listing-en
    contents:
      - "posts/**/*.qmd"
      - "!en/posts/**/*.qmd"
      - "!starter-template/posts/**/*.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    type: table
    fields: [date, title-en, description-en]
    field-links: [title-en]
    field-display-names:
      date: Date
      title-en: Title
      description-en: Description
    categories: true
    date-format: iso
---

::: {.content-visible unless-profile="en"}
すべての記事は日本語と英語の両方で読めます。英語版は[English Posts](en/posts.html)から参照できます。
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="en"}
Every post is available in both Japanese and English. The Japanese archive is on [Posts](../posts.html).
:::
